facts.fact: The civil registry centre of South Gezira locality (Al-Hosh office) announced it had issued an electronic birth certificate, drawn up at the office on 17 May 2026, for a child born in August 2023, as reported by Al-Nawrs News; the report does not say how the underlying record is made or held.
facts.system: civil registry centre, South Gezira locality (Al-Hosh office)

facts.fact: The Al-Hosh civil registry office in South Gezira locality resumed work after a stoppage caused by insecurity and displacement and issued its first electronic birth certificate on 17 May 2026, according to Al-Nawrs News and local sources it cites.
facts.system: civil registry centre, South Gezira locality (Al-Hosh office)

facts.fact: One local office is named as issuing an electronic birth certificate on 17 May 2026: the Al-Hosh office of the South Gezira locality civil registry centre, serving the locality and its surrounding rural villages; no total of offices is given (Al-Nawrs News).
facts.system: civil registry centre, South Gezira locality (Al-Hosh office)
